shots.prompt: A fast hook on the product. The jar from <Picture 1>, a frosted white glass jar with a gold lid, stands on a polished white pedestal against a soft pearl-grey studio background, front of the label facing the camera, a thin glint of light running over the gold lid. [Shot 1 (0.0-0.5 s)] Wide product shot, the jar centred, the light glint starting at the left. [Shot 2 (0.5-0.75 s)] Tighter on the lid, the glint crossing it. [Shot 3 (0.75-1.0 s)] Extreme close-up on the gold rim catching the light, ending on a fast whip pan into the next image. Slow locked-off camera, soft high-key light.
shots.image_prompt: Product shot of a frosted white glass jar with a gold lid on a white pedestal, pearl-grey studio, soft light, vertical 9:16.
shots.notes: Hook: the product, wide to extreme close-up; the last cut whips into the model.

shots.prompt: A quick burst on the model. The woman from <Picture 2>, with a sleek dark bob and a white silk top, faces the camera in a bright studio with a pale backdrop, her skin luminous, and slowly turns her head from left to right. The shot opens with a burst of bright light, then four quick cuts: [Shot 1 (0.0-0.25 s)] close-up, her eyes on the lens. [Shot 2 (0.25-0.5 s)] the same close-up seen from the opposite side, her head turning. [Shot 3 (0.5-0.75 s)] extreme close-up on her cheek and eye. [Shot 4 (0.75-1.0 s)] a slightly wider frame, a small smile. Locked-off camera, soft high-key light.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up portrait of a woman with a dark bob and luminous skin, white silk top, bright pale studio, vertical 9:16.
shots.notes: Burst: four cuts on the model, with a glow.

shots.prompt: A calm comparison, the model on the left and the product on the right of the same bright studio. The woman from <Picture 2> raises her chin and touches her cheek with two fingers, slowly, while the jar from <Picture 1> stays still beside her. [Shot 1 (0.0-0.75 s)] medium shot, her hand rising to her cheek. [Shot 2 (0.75-1.5 s)] close-up, her fingers resting on her skin, a soft smile. Steady camera, soft high-key light, a slow gentle push-in.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of a woman touching her cheek, bright pale studio, vertical 9:16.
shots.notes: Comparison: the model on the left, the glowing close-up of SHOT_004 on the right.

shots.prompt: A glowing close-up. The woman from <Picture 2>, with a sleek dark bob and a white silk top, looks into the camera in a bright pale studio, her skin radiant, and exhales with a slow, relaxed smile while a soft light flares at the edge of the frame. Slow locked-off camera, soft high-key light.
shots.image_prompt: Radiant close-up of a woman smiling, luminous skin, bright pale studio, vertical 9:16.
shots.notes: The glow of her skin; the close-up that SHOT_003 compares with.

shots.prompt: A texture macro. A swirl of thick white cream with a satin sheen turns slowly on a pearl-grey surface, the gold lid of the jar from <Picture 1> out of focus in the background, soft light, a slow macro camera drifting to the right.
shots.image_prompt: Macro of a swirl of thick white cream on a pearl-grey surface, soft light, vertical 9:16.
shots.notes: Texture, with the jar of SHOT_001 in the corner.

shots.prompt: The payoff. The jar from <Picture 1>, a frosted white glass jar with a gold lid, stands centred on a white pedestal in a bright pearl-grey studio, the woman from <Picture 2>, with a sleek dark bob and a white silk top, behind it and slightly out of focus, her skin radiant. The jar turns a few degrees to show its label, then rests. A very slow push-in, soft high-key light, clean empty space in the upper third of the frame.
shots.image_prompt: Hero shot of a frosted white jar with a gold lid on a pedestal, a blurred woman behind it, pearl-grey studio, vertical 9:16.
shots.notes: Payoff and end card with the product name.
